name: My Lovely Stepsister
source:
The main character meets his alluring and mysterious step-sister, who unexpectedly comes to visit. Every chance encounter, every surge of emotions, every word - all intertwine into an unforgettable atmosphere of unpredicted feelings.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角遇到了他迷人而神秘的继妹，她意外地来访。每一次的偶遇，每一次的情绪涌动，每一句话，都交织成一种难以预料的难忘氛围。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525230/]Steam[/url]]
